resources.string: Try Link sign-in in your own app with the Link Auth SDK.
Paste the Android app configuration from Console.
Create an Android app in Console with the details below and import its public JSON config. You can change the configuration after signing out.
A local log of recent actions. Authorization codes, sign-in links and tokens are never shown.
Server sign-out is waiting for a connection
Loading the configuration and the saved session…
Connect an Android app from Console.
Configuration connected and saved on the device.
Confirm the sign-in in Link, then return to the demo. If an install page opened, check the Link app and its domain association.
A return from Link arrived before the SDK was configured. Connect a configuration and start the sign-in again.
The sign-in timed out. Start again.
Session checked; an expiring token is refreshed automatically.
You signed out of the demo.
The local session is disabled. Retry the server sign-out when a connection is available.
The configuration is larger than 64 KiB.
The SDK rejected the configuration. Import the complete JSON from Console.
A public client config is required. A file with client_secret or private_key is not accepted.
A link_oauth_client_config for the android platform is required.
Add me.linkmessenger.auth.demo://oauth/callback to the app\'s Redirect URIs in Console and download the config again.
The selected file could not be read.
Android could not open the authorization link.
The SDK instance is closed. Restart the demo.
Check the scopes allowed for the app in Console.
Network error. Check the connection and try again.
The server returned an unsuitable OAuth configuration.
The SDK rejected an invalid callback. The current sign-in attempt is preserved.
Secure storage is unavailable or corrupted.
Sign in with Link again. If a session is still shown, sign out of the demo first.
The previous operation is still running.
The SDK rejected the token response. A new sign-in is required.
The server returned an HTTP error. Check the connection and the app settings.
The server rejected the OAuth request. Check the app settings in Console.
